question:
**Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:**

The **tripos** system at Cambridge remains a model of academic rigor.

options.text: The **tripos** involved oral defense and written modules.
He broke his **tripos** into discrete phases of analysis.
The ceremonial **tripos** stool toppled during the investiture.
She passed the natural sciences **tripos** with distinction.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"tripos"** refers to the Cambridge University examination system, which is divided into parts for different subjects. (त्रिपॉस - कैम्ब्रिज विश्वविद्यालय में परीक्षा प्रणाली)

 
 
• **Example:** She excelled in her natural sciences tripos and was awarded distinction.
 
 
 
• The homonym of **"tripos"** is also used to refer to a ceremonial stool or a tripod-like object. (त्रिपॉस - एक प्रकार का त्रिपाद या स्टूल)
 
 
• **Example:** The tripos stool fell to the ground during the ceremony.
 
 
 
• In this context, the highlighted word "tripos" in Option 3 refers to the ceremonial stool, which is different from the Cambridge examination system.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__
 
• **Option 1:** The tripos involved oral defense and written modules. (त्रिपॉस - कैम्ब्रिज विश्वविद्यालय में परीक्षा प्रणाली)

 
 
• **Example:** The tripos at Cambridge University tests both written and oral skills.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** He broke his tripos into discrete phases of analysis. (त्रिपॉस - कैम्ब्रिज विश्वविद्यालय में परीक्षा प्रणाली)
 
 
• **Example:** His tripos preparation strategy involved dividing tasks into smaller parts.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** She passed the natural sciences tripos with distinction. (त्रिपॉस - कैम्ब्रिज विश्वविद्यालय में परीक्षा प्रणाली)
 
 
• **Example:** Her dedication earned her distinction in the natural sciences tripos.
